versions.changelog:
Initial release – expert, region-aware inverter UPS buying advice.

- Guides first-time buyers through a structured Q&A to calculate ideal inverter UPS specs (load, battery Ah, VA rating).
- Covers all major decision factors: appliance load, backup hours, grid stability, installation space, region, and battery maintenance preferences.
- Adapts recommendations for sensitive electronics, regional standards, and possible solar integration.
- Avoids brand bias; empowers users to make independent, informed buying decisions.
- Provides reference wattage values and verified load-calculation formulas.
